description:

title: The Vet Life
description:

title: The Vet Life
description:

Dr. Lavigne performs a risky surgery on a loving pit bull with a record-breaking tumor; Dr. Ross examines a rescue pigeon turned pet; an aspiring vet student joins Dr. Blue at Cy-Fair; the doctors deal with a heartbreaking situation at the clinic.

description:
S05 E05 — Einstein Hates Izzy
Einstein the cat ferociously attacks whenever he sees the other house cat, Izzy; a couple expecting their first baby must make a decision about their indoor cat, Ben who was diagnosed with Toxoplasmosis which could threaten the newborn's life.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S06 E02 — Scared to Laugh
Alex fears that when she leaves for college, her mother will get rid of her cat, Meeko, who pees all over the house and attacks people; clients will not come to Kelly's home because her cat, Symone, will attack anyone who laughs or cries.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S05 E03 — Surprise Attack Cat!

description:

description:

title: I Was Prey
description:

title: I Was Prey
description:
S02 E02 — 20-Foot Terror
Micki Glenn is attacked by a shark during a dive trip; hours from the nearest medical facility, she has to rely on her husband and friends to save her life; a couple is attacked by a giraffe while on safari.

title: I Was Prey
description:

Nicole Moore's vacation in Cancun, Mexico, gets cut short when a shark attacks her close to shore; in Tennessee, a timber rattlesnake bites firefighter Kyle Watson while he hikes in the woods with his family.

description:

title: Tanked
description:

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E06 — View from Above IV
Taking a look back at builds from the past is always a joy for Pete Nelson and the carpenters of NT&S; Pete and a few crew members gather around the campfire to poke fun at one another about the shenanigans they shared when building in the trees.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E09 — A Treehouse Production
A friend of Pete's has the tree house bug and decides to open a tree house B&B; the classic A-Frame structure has all the amenities and a waterfall that pours from the wraparound deck to the pond below.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E11 — Ultimate Treehouses VI
Pete Nelson seeks out the most wonderful arboreal structures in the world, highlighting how each has been swayed by different artistic movements, while also appreciating function and form.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E10 — Climb-In Drive-In
Pete tackles the first climb-in movie theater; concessions are served to seating pods through a pulley system and loungers elevate into the trees to give perfect views of the big screen; a tree house for monkeys at the Los Angeles Zoo.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E04 — Antonio Brown's Steel City Skybox
Pete makes a treehouse touchdown in Pittsburgh for Antonio Brown, wide receiver for the Pittsburgh Steelers; his plan is to build a luxury skybox with a two-story window wall that overlooks a custom basketball court and football field.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E07 — Lifted Lodge Treehouse
The NTS crew travels to an alpaca farm to build a lodge in the trees inspired by national parks; they create a structure to take in the mountain views with a 50-foot-long cable bridge entrance and a deck devoted entirely to hammock lounging.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E02 — Hot Tub Rumpus Room
Pete's fun-loving friend is the lucky recipient of a treehouse built strictly for good times; the team builds a dream of a treehouse complete with a wine bar, a loft, and their first-ever hot tub in the woods of Western Washington.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E08 — Semper Fi in the Sky
Pete answers the call of duty to build a tree house in Pennsylvania that focuses on the children of Marines; cargo netting off the deck provides an exciting way to enter, while even more nets inside form a bridge to access a private loft space.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S11 E03 — Never Too Old for a Treehouse
